steps.step_name: Monitor status of open student tickets
Coordinate student tickets by forwarding cases and checking pending issues
steps.time_needed: 20 minutes to a couple of hours

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Missing or wrong information provided by the student in the ticket
exceptions.impact: Delays processing by a few hours
exceptions.recovery: Request the student to resubmit the correct information; handling these errors usually takes about 10 to 15 minutes each time

steps.step_name: Coordinate complaints by forwarding cases and checking pending issues
steps.time_needed: 20 minutes to a couple of hours

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Missing reference documents in the complaint management process
exceptions.impact: Delays verification and causes time-consuming follow-up; chasing missing documents can take a couple of hours each time
exceptions.recovery: Contact external sources to obtain the missing documents

steps.step_name: Coordinate incidents by forwarding cases and checking pending issues
steps.time_needed: 20 minutes to a couple of hours

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Incident status not updated correctly in the Incident Management System leading to miscommunication about incident progress
exceptions.impact: Creates a bottleneck and requires manual correction
exceptions.recovery: Review logs and manually update the status; sorting out and correcting the updates usually takes about 15 to 30 minutes
